title: HMGCC Challenge Seeks Hostile RF Emitter Detection Tech
summary: The HMGCC is launching a challenge to create technology that can identify hostile RF emitters in battlefield situations.

title: University of Hertfordshire Researching Grenfell Chimney Effect
summary: Researchers are launching a study into the chimney effect that helped fire and smoke spread rapidly during the Grenfell Tower disaster.

title: Quantum Computing Revenue Surpasses $1 Billion in 2025
summary: Quantum computing revenue surpassed $1 billion in 2025 while missing forecasts, highlighting the gap between expectations and delivery.

title: Jacobs Appointed Contractor for £1bn California Wastewater Plant
summary: Jacobs has been appointed as the progressive design-build contractor for the Southeast Treatment Plant Nutrient Reduction Project.

title: UKAEA Installs 12t Vessel to Boost Fusion Facility Heat
summary: A 12t stainless-steel containment vessel has been installed at the UKAEA Culham campus for the Mast Upgrade.

title: Unified 3D-IC Signal Integrity Environment Announced
summary: A new unified environment spans architecture exploration, extraction, simulation, compliance verification, and system-level signoff.

title: Application Fit in Power Transistors
summary: Silicon MOSFETs, IGBTs, SiC MOSFETs, and GaN HEMTs offer distinct advantages that vary across power stages and converters.

title: Neural Super Resolution Overview
summary: Neural graphics improve image quality and performance while simplifying deployment on constrained devices.

title: GPS-Based Speed Limiters Deployed in US
summary: The US has started deploying GPS-based speed-limiting devices on cars to prevent reckless drivers from exceeding limits.

title: Filtronic Wins £1.9M DCMS Contract
summary: Filtronic secured a £1.9 million contract under the Advanced Connectivity Technologies competition delivered by Innovate UK.

title: MIT-Led Team Receives ARPA-H Funding for Wearable Monitor
summary: The team received up to $38 million to develop a low-power, noninvasive sensor patch for early disease detection.

title: Realbotix Launches Tabletop Humanoids Under $12,000
summary: Las Vegas-based Realbotix introduced four tabletop humanoid models focusing on the top half to achieve lower consumer pricing.

title: Robot Dogs Conquer 3,100 Mountain Steps
summary: Robot dogs were tested by racing up over 3,000 uneven stone steps on a mountain to aid in machine training.

title: India's Chip Packaging Boom and Small OSATs
summary: Small OSATs in India can start with an investment of up to ₹2 billion, though survival depends on anchor customers, skilled staff, and qualification.

title: NASA Explores Options to Save Hubble
summary: NASA is asking industry for ideas to extend the work of the healthy Hubble Space Telescope as atmospheric drag pulls it toward Earth.

title: Europe's Hera Probe Spots Dimorphos
summary: Europe's Hera planetary defense spacecraft is closing in on the binary asteroid system and can now distinguish the two rocky bodies.

title: DreamX Universal Latent Action Learner
summary: Researchers introduced DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner for cross-embodiment transfer.

title: Bayesian Optimized Model for Real-Time EEG Phase Estimation
summary: A Bayesian-Optimized Biquad Filter-Burg model achieves matched or better real-time EEG phase estimation performance at a fraction of calibration time.

title: Iterative Methods for Feedback-Type Linear Equations
summary: This paper investigates iterative methods for solving feedback-type linear equations under the small phase condition using numerical-radius contraction.

title: GUILD Guided Iterative Data Collection for Imitation Learning
summary: GUILD is a guided data collection method that uses semantic priors and data attribution to improve sample efficiency in robotics.

title: Randomized Caches in Hardware: Overheads And Limitations
summary: Researchers explore the challenges, overheads, and practical implementation trade-offs of using randomized caches to prevent side-channel attacks.

title: Analyzing Action-Token Supervision in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs
summary: Researchers investigated how gradient insulation and action-token supervision impact vision-language-action model performance in driving and manipulation.

title: Reality and Perceptual Gaps in Swarm Robotics
summary: This study examines robotic swarms deployed across multiple platforms, revealing that physical embodiment alters motion timescales and human emotional responses.

title: Simera Sense and Spacemanic Partner on Dual-Use Satellite
summary: Spacemanic and Simera Sense are collaborating to deliver a compact, dual-use satellite solution named xScape200.

title: OperAItor Framework for Chemical Fault Management
summary: OperAItor is an open-source framework using large language model agents for supervisory fault management in chemical processes.

title: Novelty Horizon Limits LLM Scientific Data Generation
summary: Large Language Models fail to generate scientific data beyond their training distribution due to a lack of physical grounding and extrapolation.

title: Unified Motion Correction for Accelerated ZTE MRI
summary: EnMoCo is a regularized maximum a posteriori formulation designed to jointly estimate 3D images and rigid-motion parameters in accelerated ZTE MRI.

title: High-Resolution Quantitative MRI Using MuSE Regularization
summary: Researchers introduced a diffusion-model-based reconstruction for quantitative MRI at 0.5 mm isotropic resolution using a pre-trained multiscale energy model.

title: Optimal Control Foundation of Early Exits in ResNets
summary: Using optimal control theory, researchers prove that ResNets trained with joint intermediate layer outputs exhibit the turnpike phenomenon.

title: DexHOT: Learning Hand-Object Configuration Transfer
summary: DexHOT formulates dexterous manipulation as hand-object configuration transfer to move between feasible configurations specifying hand articulation and object pose.
